originality.rationale: The novel assessed statement is the exact all-positive-index algebraic first-passage survival equivalent with evaluated prefactor and the conditional product of geometric completed-reset count and Rayleigh scaled survivor endpoint, with asymptotically negligible last reset epoch. The general renewal transform, unconditional geometric number of failed attempts, and mean finiteness criterion are already covered by Godrèche and Luck §7 and are explicitly excluded from the novelty assertion. Closest primary mathematical and physical papers have been materially inspected and explicit implication comparisons recorded. Residual risk: these asymptotic refinements may be implicit in broad renewal/regular variation literature.

value.rationale: A significant physical asymptotic distinction for search with Pareto resetting is established for all positive finite clock exponents: even a finite-mean reset clock cannot remove the ultimate algebraic survival tail. The exact coefficient and the conditional geometric–Rayleigh product explain the mechanism and late-failure trajectories, with applications to search-time risk beyond mean performance. The mean-integrability boundary and generic renewal equation are acknowledged prior results, not intrinsic value claims.
